definitions.gloss: from now on, hereafter, in the future
definitions.explanation: The time from the present moment onwards.

examples.japanese: {今後|こんご}ともよろしくお{願|ねが}いします。
examples.english: I look forward to your continued support.

examples.japanese: {今後|こんご}は{気|き}をつけます。
examples.english: I will be careful from now on.

examples.japanese: {今後|こんご}の{経済|けいざい}{動向|どうこう}について、{専門家|せんもんか}たちは{慎重|しんちょう}な{見方|みかた}を{示|しめ}している。
examples.english: Experts are showing a cautious outlook regarding future economic trends.

notes:
{今後|こんご} means from now onward.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {今後|こんご}とも (continuing from now on)
- {今後|こんご}の〜 (future ~)
- {今後|こんご}は〜する (will ~ from now on)

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
- {今後|こんご}: from now on (formal)
- これから: from now on (casual)
- {将来|しょうらい}: future, in the future
- {以後|いご}: after this, hereafter
